events.description: Monica Geller says that not having the shoes bothers Monica Geller very much.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is considering going out to get the shoes but also tells herself not to follow through with that plan.
Monica Geller says that this internal debate about whether to go get the shoes is stupid.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller does not have to prove anything.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is going to go get the shoes.
Monica Geller says everyone will know that Monica Geller got the shoes.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller will wake up very early after getting the shoes.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller will put the shoes back after getting the shoes.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller needs help.
